room_line: DEWI SILUMAN ULAR owns the clearest awareness signal; the sharper upside tests belong to audience affinity and finished-film response.
coming_kick: Treat domestic play as a working assumption under existing eligibility filters, never as confirmed booking or DCP.
coming_caveat: Explicit exclusions and fixed or promo obligations override that assumption; absent comparable ordinary play makes a comparison NOT_TESTABLE. coming.meta: Anya Geraldine, Derby Romero and Starvision: supported by Aulia Sarah and Aghniny Haque, directed by Azhar Kinoi Lubis, with Chand Parwez Servia among the producers.
coming.logline: A debt-stricken husband marries Dewi, a serpent spirit promising wealth, only to expose his family to the lethal consequences of their supernatural pact.
coming.quality: Independent quality remains insufficient evidence: captured articles describe a socially grounded supernatural horror, but none provides a credible, independent assessment of the finished film.
coming.gold: Accessible debt-and-pesugihan horror: recognizable cast, a claimed 5.6-million-view source story and contemporary pinjol parallels create a legible hook, but not proven ticket demand.
coming.promo: Active BOGOF messaging: one captured TikTok post promotes beli 1 gratis 1 tiket across multiple ticket channels, but offer terms, inventory and redemption were not independently captured.
coming.social: Modest campaign reach, weak visible interaction: ten captured TikTok results total 30,186 views, 224 likes, four comments and ten shares, with no representative intent signal.
coming.demand: Ticket demand remains insufficient evidence: national listings and BOGOF messaging show purchase proximity, but no SAMS booking, presales, occupancy, redemption or buyer-intent data was captured.
coming.risk: Unproven conversion under subsidy: the film has a clear hook and active campaign, but quality, organic purchase intent and SAMS-local eligibility remain unresolved.
coming.bet: DEWI SILUMAN ULAR will lead a matched domestic-horror comparator in ordinary ADM/show on Day 1 and retain the lead through Day 4.
coming.nug: The debt-to-pesugihan premise gains a contemporary pinjol parallel and a reported 5.6-million-view source story—recognition, not ticket demand.

lanes.read: Captured synopsis: debt-stricken Dedi marries serpent spirit Dewi for wealth and exposes his family to lethal consequences. Decision: test the specific debt-pesugihan family hook, not generic supernatural horror.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured full text consistently describes Dedi choosing a supernatural marriage and pesugihan under severe financial pressure.
lanes.decision_consequence: Use the clear pesugihan, debt and family-stakes premise when testing whether the film fits SAMS audiences; do not reduce it to generic supernatural horror.

lanes.read: A captured production listing names Anya Geraldine, Derby Romero and Starvision as the principal awareness assets. Decision: require observed local conversion before assigning them commercial strength.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A captured production listing names Starvision, the principal cast, director Azhar Kinoi Lubis and producers Chand Parwez Servia, Riza and Mithu Nisar.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat Anya Geraldine, Derby Romero and Starvision as the principal awareness assets, while requiring observed local conversion before assigning commercial strength.

lanes.read: Captured press establishes debt, family pressure and pesugihan themes, but no independent finished-film assessment. Decision: award no quality premium; retain a neutral prior until ordinary performance supplies evidence.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The available full text identifies debt, family pressure and pesugihan as thematic material, while its evaluative language comes from promotional or press-conference framing rather than independent criticism.
lanes.missing_fact: A readable independent review or post-screening assessment addressing execution, scares, pacing and audience response.
lanes.decision_consequence: Do not award a quality premium on Monday; retain a neutral quality prior and let later ordinary-performance evidence revise it.

lanes.read: Coverage links debt and pesugihan to pinjol and reports 5.6 million views for the source story. Decision: carry a plausible mass-market horror hook only if eligibility, local affinity and an ordinary comparator are confirmed; recognition is not ticket demand.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Captured coverage links the story to economic pressure and pinjol, while trailer coverage says the source podcast story had exceeded 5.6 million views.
lanes.decision_consequence: Carry the film as a plausible mass-market horror proposition, but keep any opening expectation conditional on SAMS eligibility, local affinity and comparable ordinary play.

lanes.read: A November 7 TikTok sample advertises buy-one-get-one tickets across major ticket channels, but terms and redemption were not captured. Decision: mark support present and isolate any subsidized rows from ordinary demand.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A captured November 7 TikTok sample explicitly promotes first-day tickets with a buy-one-get-one message across M-TIX, CGV, Cinépolis and TIX ID.
lanes.decision_consequence: Mark launch support as present but separate subsidized attendance from ordinary demand; any affected SAMS rows must be isolated before performance comparison.

lanes.read: Modest campaign reach, weak visible interaction: ten captured TikTok results total 30,186 views, 224 likes, four comments and ten shares, with no representative intent signal.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The directional sample's largest item reached 7,832 views, while aggregate visible interaction was approximately 0.8% of sampled views and comments were scarce.
lanes.decision_consequence: Count this as awareness support only; do not translate the sampled reach or engagement into a show allocation or ticket-demand claim.

lanes.read: Listings and BOGOF messaging create purchase proximity, but no SAMS booking, presales, occupancy, redemption or buyer-intent data was captured. Decision: retain only the domestic-release working assumption if eligible; no comparable ordinary play means NOT_TESTABLE.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: A captured listing page displays Jakarta sessions and ticket links, while social evidence carries a launch offer; neither establishes local SAMS demand.
lanes.missing_fact: Confirmed SAMS play and context, local presales or occupancy, and comparable ordinary ADM/show after opening.
lanes.decision_consequence: Keep the title in Monday planning under the owner-authorized domestic-release working assumption, not as confirmed booking or DCP. A confirmed eligible local play keeps it live; an exclusion removes it; affinity informs only the prior; absent comparable eligible ordinary play makes the comparison NOT_TESTABLE.

lanes.read: Campaign activity and a clear hook coexist with unresolved quality, organic intent and SAMS eligibility. Decision: confirm eligibility, affinity and comparator and isolate fixed, promo, event or support rows; otherwise the comparison is NOT_TESTABLE.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The bundle contains campaign activity and thematic press coverage but no independent quality verdict, local booking evidence or transaction signal.
lanes.decision_consequence: Before opening, Programming must answer local eligibility, producer or context exclusions, audience affinity and the named comparator. Fixed, promo, NOMAT, event or support contexts override ordinary comparison; if either title lacks comparable eligible play, record NOT_TESTABLE rather than a performance loss.

coming.meta: Aurora Ribero, Rey Bong and BASE Entertainment: ensemble cast includes Gabriella Ekaputri, Daffa Wardhana, Arafah Rianti and Lutfi Afansyah; directed by Archie Hekagery.
coming.logline: Six young probationary employees form workplace bonds before learning they must compete against one another for a single permanent position.
coming.quality: Quality remains unproven: direct workplace, HR and rush-hour KRL research supports intended authenticity, but no readable independent review judges the finished film.
coming.gold: Relatable young-worker hook: job insecurity, family pressure and six first-jobbers competing for stability create a clear Gen Z and early-career audience angle, but conversion is unproven.
coming.promo: Active launch campaign: BASE Entertainment released an official trailer and poster, held press events and generated cast-and-director coverage close to release; campaign activity is not demand.
coming.social: Visible but shallow social response: six captured TikTok posts reached at most 4,569 views, with zero comments on every sample; the Instagram keyword sample was largely unrelated.
coming.demand: No positive pre-release demand signal was captured for this title: six title-specific TikTok posts peaked at 4,569 views with zero comments, while release-date coverage supplied no presale, seat-fill, sold-out, booking-velocity or other attributable purchase evidence. This supports no demand premium, not a conclusion of zero demand.
coming.risk: Conversion and context risk: modest social response, no purchase evidence and no finished-film verdict leave the relatable premise commercially unvalidated; absence of captured backlash does not remove that uncertainty.
coming.bet: At younger-worker-affinity sites, the title will beat an eligible domestic comedy-drama comparator on Day-4 ordinary ADM/show.
coming.nug: Its clearest edge is first-jobber anxiety: six peers are asked to bond, then compete for one secure job.

lanes.read: The Film Indonesia synopsis shows six probationary employees bonding before competing for one permanent job. Decision: test a specific first-jobber and workplace-survival mechanism, not generic youth appeal.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The captured Film Indonesia synopsis identifies Bintang, five fellow probationary employees and the one-position competition that turns teamwork into conflict.
lanes.decision_consequence: The room can evaluate a clear workplace-survival premise rather than relying on cast awareness alone.

lanes.read: Captured coverage names Aurora Ribero, Rey Bong, the young ensemble and BASE Entertainment. Decision: use familiarity to frame the affinity question, not to award a demand premium.
lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Medcom directly identifies BASE Entertainment, director Archie Hekagery and the six principal performers.
lanes.decision_consequence: The recognizable young ensemble supports audience-affinity discussion, but talent familiarity alone should not create a demand premium.

lanes.read: Workplace, HR and KRL research supports intended authenticity, but no independent review judges the completed film. Decision: treat authenticity as adjacent evidence and award no quality premium.

lanes.missing_fact: A readable independent review or attributable post-screening assessment of the finished film.
lanes.decision_consequence: Treat authenticity as a production-positive adjacent signal, not a quality verdict or reason to raise the commercial prior.

lanes.decision_consequence: Before opening, name sites with demonstrated younger-worker or first-jobber affinity; named sites become observation targets, while no identified affinity means no audience-based uplift.

lanes.decision_consequence: Expect baseline awareness around opening, but do not convert press activity into a higher demand prior without ticket or audience evidence.

coming.meta: Benidictus Siregar; Sinergi Pictures and Ben Film: with Chicco Kurniawan, Teuku Rifnu Wikana, Tika Panggabean and Dewi Irawan; directed by Kuntz Agus.
coming.logline: A depressed 37-year-old seeking one final bowl of chicken noodles is diverted into encounters that gradually give him new reasons to remain alive.
coming.quality: Promising, reflective and deliberately paced: one independent review praises the warm script, convincing lead performance and humane treatment of depression, while warning that the episodic rhythm may feel slow.
coming.gold: Targeted adult emotional drama: the familiar novel premise, mental-health theme and Benidictus Siregar's dramatic lead turn offer affinity for source readers and reflective-drama audiences, not automatic mass appeal.
coming.promo: Active digital push, limited proven scale: ten fresh TikTok samples on November 7 repeatedly carried the November 12 date and emotional hooks, but no fetched evidence proves a major roadshow, offer or broad activation.
coming.social: Visible response is modest and shallow: the ten-post TikTok sample recorded 108–804 views, 6–61 likes, 0–2 comments and 0–6 shares per post; it is directional, not representative or purchase intent.
coming.demand: Insufficient evidence for ticket demand: November 12 Jakarta showtimes and prices create a visible purchase path, but the bundle contains no presale volume, occupancy, sold-out sessions or buyer conversion.
coming.risk: Main risk is narrow appeal, not a proven rejection: the film is slow, emotionally heavy and listed 17+, while local SAMS eligibility remains a working assumption rather than a confirmed booking or DCP.
coming.bet: Across Day 1 and Day 4, this title will match or exceed a room-named adult drama in ordinary ADM/show at least once.
coming.nug: A bestselling-novel premise and Benidictus Siregar’s dramatic turn provide a precise adult-emotional hook, not proven mass appeal.

lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The fetched Informasi.com article describes Ale's planned suicide, the closed noodle stall and the encounters that alter his perspective.
lanes.decision_consequence: Frame it as an intimate survival drama rather than horror or broad comedy.

lanes.decision_consequence: Replace the provisional unknown production-house field and pitch the ensemble plus Benidictus's dramatic turn, not an unverified producer reputation.

lanes.decision_consequence: Carry a positive but narrow quality prior; do not present one review as a broad critical verdict.

lanes.decision_consequence: Treat promotion as current awareness support, not as a reason to raise the demand prior or presume uplift.

lanes.decision_consequence: Keep social sentiment mildly encouraging but commercially neutral until ticket or admissions evidence appears.

lanes.strongest_available_evidence: Jadwalnonton displays multiple November 12 Jakarta sessions and ticket prices, establishing availability rather than demand.
lanes.missing_fact: Presale seats sold, occupancy or another transaction-level purchase measure before opening.

lanes.strongest_available_evidence: The independent review flags slow pacing, and the fetched schedule page lists a 17+ rating; no explicit standing producer exclusion is captured.

attention_heading: Three decisions to settle before opening

attention.label: 1. Gate each title before ranking
attention.why: YES to ordinary eligibility with no fixed, promo, event, NOBAR, NOMAT or support distortion keeps a title testable; NO removes it from ordinary comparison.
attention.action: DEWI: isolate any BOGOF rows. LAGI: confirm ordinary availability. PASUKAN: resolve producer or booking constraints. SEPORSI: confirm eligible 17+ ordinary play.

attention.label: 2. Name affinity or award no uplift
attention.why: YES activates only the named audience hypothesis; NO leaves a neutral prior rather than a negative demand claim.
attention.action: Answer separately: DEWI—domestic horror; LAGI—first-jobber; PASUKAN—family, Aceh/history or women-led action; SEPORSI—adult reflective drama.

attention.label: 3. Predeclare a comparator or stop
attention.why: YES to same-site comparable ordinary play permits Day-1 and Day-4 ADM/show measurement; NO makes the claim NOT_TESTABLE, not won or lost.
attention.action: DEWI—matched horror. LAGI and SEPORSI—compare only at predeclared affinity sites. PASUKAN—ordinary domestic comparator. Any context mismatch stops the comparison.

what_milo_sees.title: DEWI SILUMAN ULAR
what_milo_sees.insight: It has the slate's clearest awareness shape: 30,186 sampled promo views plus a reported 5.6-million-view source story. That is recognition, not conversion; weak interaction and unresolved BOGOF effects keep the demand claim below the hook.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Is it eligible for ordinary play, is any BOGOF or other promo obligation applicable, which markets have domestic-horror affinity, and what matched horror comparator is available?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: Ordinary eligibility, no distorting obligation, credible horror affinity and a same-site matched comparator are all confirmed.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: It is excluded, promo-led, lacks local horror affinity or cannot be compared in ordinary contexts.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Retain eligible domestic play only as a working assumption; claim no local uplift, and mark the comparison NOT_TESTABLE without comparable ordinary play.

public_signal_shape.comparison: Broader sampled reach than the slate's other captured shapes, but samples are unlike and no difference or ratio is inferred; the 5.6-million source-story figure is recognition, not ticket intent.

what_milo_sees.evidence: Recognizable leads, Starvision and a debt-pesugihan hook support awareness. Weak sampled interaction, unverified BOGOF applicability and no SAMS transaction evidence block a demand conclusion.

what_milo_sees.title: SEPORSI MIE AYAM SEBELUM MATI
what_milo_sees.insight: Its edge is not reach but a narrow quality prior: one independent review found it warm and convincing while noting slow pacing. Against LAGI PROBATION: KERJA NGEJAR APA SIH?, it offers finished-film evidence versus a stronger audience-affinity thesis.
what_milo_sees.room_question: Is it ordinarily eligible, which markets have adult reflective-drama affinity, and can it be compared with LAGI PROBATION: KERJA NGEJAR APA SIH? in similar ordinary contexts?
what_milo_sees.strengthens_if: Adult-drama affinity is credible, the 17+ and slow-pacing constraints fit the market, and both titles have comparable eligible ordinary play.
what_milo_sees.weakens_if: The market skews away from adult reflective drama, or an exclusion, obligation or context mismatch prevents a clean comparison.
what_milo_sees.decision_if_unresolved: Keep the quality mechanism as a low-confidence prior, not a demand claim; without comparable ordinary contexts, mark the comparison NOT_TESTABLE.

public_signal_shape.comparison: One warm but qualified review supplies a narrow quality prior; LAGI PROBATION: KERJA NGEJAR APA SIH? has first-jobber relevance but no independent finished-film evidence.

what_milo_sees.evidence: The novel adaptation, Benidictus Siregar's dramatic turn and one independent review support an adult-emotional mechanism. TikTok exposure of 108–804 views and absent transaction evidence do not establish mass demand.

non_consensus_hypothesis.title: SEPORSI MIE AYAM SEBELUM MATI
non_consensus_hypothesis.hypothesis: At room-confirmed adult reflective-drama affinity sites, SEPORSI MIE AYAM SEBELUM MATI will match or exceed LAGI PROBATION: KERJA NGEJAR APA SIH? in ordinary ADM/show at least once across Day 1 and Day 4.
non_consensus_hypothesis.evidence: SEPORSI's one independent review directly judges the finished film: warm script, convincing lead and humane treatment of depression, with slow pacing as a constraint. LAGI's first-jobber case is supported by premise and workplace, HR and KRL research, but no independent finished-film verdict, purchase signal or attributable ticket evidence was captured. SEPORSI is therefore one evidence step closer to observed audience experience, not evidence of broader demand.
non_consensus_hypothesis.why_non_consensus: Its 17+ rating, slow pacing and 108–804-view TikTok sample make it easy to dismiss before testing whether finished-film warmth travels better than campaign reach.
non_consensus_hypothesis.strongest_alternative_title: LAGI PROBATION: KERJA NGEJAR APA SIH?
non_consensus_hypothesis.why_stronger_than_alternative: The alternative is commercially broader because first-jobber anxiety is relatable. SEPORSI is better supported only for a conditional quality-led test: its mechanism has been observed in the completed film, while LAGI's remains a plausible premise. The review does not override SEPORSI's 17+, slow-pacing and narrow-appeal risks.
non_consensus_hypothesis.falsifier: Falsified if both titles receive comparable eligible ordinary play at predeclared affinity sites and SEPORSI records lower ordinary ADM/show at both Day 1 and Day 4. Missing comparable play is NOT_TESTABLE, not falsification.
